verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a REST API (OAuth 2.0, retrieval and PATCH endpoints, webhooks) and a hosted MCP server. Nothing in the pack mentions official SDKs or client libraries in any language. A raw API and MCP endpoint are adjacent building blocks, not official SDKs, so this applicable axis has no supporting evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
